INSERT INTO KSAP_PERF_WEEKLY (CARRIER_GID, SHIPMENT_COUNT, ON_TIME_PCT)
SELECT sp.servprov_gid, COUNT(*), AVG(CASE WHEN sh.end_time <= sh.end_time_estimated THEN 100 ELSE 0 END)
FROM shipment sh
JOIN servprov sp ON sp.servprov_gid = sh.servprov_gid
WHERE sh.domain_name = 'KSAP'
AND sh.insert_date >= SYSDATE - 7
GROUP BY sp.servprov_gid
